packageRules.description: Base image digest updates: deliberate, never auto-merged. Bumping a base image without re-running the docker-acceptance suite is how regressions ship.
GitHub Actions used by the CI workflows — pin by SHA per supply-chain best practice.

LiteLLM Helm sub-chart (Epic #35 #38). PATCH bumps (1.86.x → 1.86.y) are auto-mergeable; MINOR bumps (1.86.x → 1.87.x) require manual review because upstream sometimes ships breaking values.yaml schema changes inside minors. MAJOR bumps need a full design re-evaluation — admin API shape may shift. See docs/docs/concepts/litellm-gateway.md §Version pin + bump cadence.
